name: L'Hybride
address: Nouvelle Route Bastos, entrance Banque Mondiale, Yaoundé, Cameroon
description: A modern upscale restaurant and bar in Bastos offering meals, brunches, cocktails and a varied dining experience in a contemporary setting.
bonASavoir: The restaurant offers a lunch special around 8,000 FCFA including a starter, hot dish and dessert. Sunday brunches are also offered, sometimes with access to the swimming pool.
